description: Test the competing hypothesis that the ADNP2 zinc fingers, not the homeodomain, carry DNA binding: check zinc coordination, the beta-beta-alpha core and the recognition positions of all nine annotated fingers against a human C2H2 background, with AlphaFold pLDDT per finger
code:
# =====================================================================
# The competing module. If the homeodomain cannot read DNA, the obvious
# alternative is the C2H2 array. The seed context states ADNP2 has
# "nine C2H2 zinc fingers with intact zinc-coordinating residues".
# This tests that statement and asks whether the fingers look competent.
# =====================================================================
import requests, re, numpy as np
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

H = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"}
def uj(acc, fields):
    return requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/%s.json?fields=%s" % (acc, fields),
                        timeout=90, headers=H).json()

def zf_features(acc):
    e = uj(acc, "sequence,ft_zn_fing")
    seq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    out = []
    for ft in e.get("features", []):
        if ft["type"] == "Zinc finger":
            out.append((ft["location"]["start"]["value"], ft["location"]["end"]["value"],
                        ft.get("description", "")))
    return seq, sorted(out)

# canonical C2H2: C-x(2,4)-C-x(12)-H-x(3,5)-H  (Zif268 spacing C-x2-C-x12-H-x3-H)
STRICT = re.compile(r"C.{2,4}C.{12}H.{3,5}H")
LOOSE  = re.compile(r"C.{1,5}C.{9,15}H.{2,6}H")      # tolerates non-standard spacing
def analyse_zf(seq, s, e, pad=4):
    """return dict describing the finger in the window, padded a little either side"""
    w = seq[max(0, s-1-pad): min(len(seq), e+pad)]
    m = STRICT.search(w) or LOOSE.search(w)
    d = {"window": w, "strict": bool(STRICT.search(w)), "match": None,
         "recog": None, "spacing": None, "core": None}
    if not m: return d
    f = m.group(0); d["match"] = f
    ci = [i for i, c in enumerate(f) if c == "C"][:2]
    hi = [i for i, c in enumerate(f) if c == "H"]
    hi = [hi[0], hi[-1]]
    d["spacing"] = (ci[1]-ci[0]-1, hi[0]-ci[1]-1, hi[1]-hi[0]-1)   # C-x?-C, C-x?-H, H-x?-H
    h = hi[0]
    # recognition positions -1, +2, +3, +6 are at h-7, h-5, h-4, h-1 for C-x12-H spacing
    idx = [h-7, h-5, h-4, h-1]
    if min(idx) >= 0: d["recog"] = "".join(f[i] for i in idx)
    # beta-beta-alpha core: aromatic at the position 4 before the second Cys, Leu at h-6
    core = []
    if ci[1]-4 >= 0: core.append(f[ci[1]-4])
    if h-6 >= 0: core.append(f[h-6])
    d["core"] = "".join(core)
    return d

print("=" * 78)
for acc, name in [("Q6IQ32", "ADNP2"), ("Q9H2P0", "ADNP")]:
    seq, zfs = zf_features(acc)
    print("\n%s (%s): %d annotated zinc-finger features, protein length %d" % (name, acc, len(zfs), len(seq)))
    print("  #  range        description                     strict  spacing      recog(-1,2,3,6)  core")
    nstrict = 0
    for i, (s, e, desc) in enumerate(zfs, 1):
        d = analyse_zf(seq, s, e)
        nstrict += d["strict"]
        print("  %d  %4d-%-4d  %-30s  %-6s  %-11s  %-15s  %s"
              % (i, s, e, desc[:30], d["strict"], str(d["spacing"]), str(d["recog"]), str(d["core"])))
    print("  fingers matching the canonical C-x(2,4)-C-x(12)-H-x(3,5)-H pattern: %d of %d" % (nstrict, len(zfs)))

# ---------------- background: reviewed human C2H2 proteins
print("\n" + "=" * 78)
q = ("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=xref:pfam-PF00096+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true"
     "&format=json&size=400&fields=accession,gene_primary,ft_zn_fing,sequence")
j = requests.get(q, timeout=180, headers=H).json()
nprot = len(j["results"]); tot = 0; strict = 0
per_protein = []
for e in j["results"]:
    seq = e["sequence"]["value"]
    zfs = [(f["location"]["start"]["value"], f["location"]["end"]["value"])
           for f in e.get("features", []) if f["type"] == "Zinc finger"
           and "C2H2" in (f.get("description") or "")]
    if not zfs: continue
    ns = sum(analyse_zf(seq, s, t)["strict"] for s, t in zfs)
    tot += len(zfs); strict += ns
    per_protein.append((e["primaryAccession"],
                        e.get("genes", [{}])[0].get("geneName", {}).get("value", ""),
                        len(zfs), ns, ns/len(zfs)))
print("reviewed human PF00096 proteins fetched: %d, with C2H2 features: %d" % (nprot, len(per_protein)))
print("annotated C2H2 fingers: %d, matching the canonical pattern: %d (%.1f%%)" % (tot, strict, 100*strict/tot))
fr = np.array([p[4] for p in per_protein])
print("per-protein fraction of canonical fingers: mean %.3f, median %.3f, sd %.3f"
      % (fr.mean(), np.median(fr), fr.std(ddof=1)))
a2 = [p for p in per_protein if p[0] == "Q6IQ32"]
ad = [p for p in per_protein if p[0] == "Q9H2P0"]
print("ADNP2 in this set:", a2 if a2 else "absent (no PF00096 cross-reference)")
print("ADNP  in this set:", ad if ad else "absent (no PF00096 cross-reference)")
seqA2, zfA2 = zf_features("Q6IQ32")
fa2 = sum(analyse_zf(seqA2, s, t)["strict"] for s, t, _ in zfA2) / len(zfA2)
print("ADNP2 fraction of canonical fingers = %.3f -> percentile of the human C2H2 distribution: %.1f"
      % (fa2, 100*(fr < fa2).mean()))

# ---------------- AlphaFold confidence over each ADNP2 finger
af = requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6IQ32", timeout=120, headers=H).json()
pdb = requests.get(af[0]["pdbUrl"], timeout=180, headers=H).text
pl = {}
for ln in pdb.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip() == "CA":
        pl[int(ln[22:26])] = float(ln[60:66])
allp = np.array([pl[k] for k in sorted(pl)])
print("\nAlphaFold %s: whole-chain mean pLDDT %.1f" % (af[0]["pdbUrl"].split("/")[-1], allp.mean()))
print("  finger   range        mean pLDDT   %% > 70   canonical")
zf_plddt = []
for i, (s, e, desc) in enumerate(zfA2, 1):
    v = np.array([pl[k] for k in range(s, e+1) if k in pl])
    d = analyse_zf(seqA2, s, e)
    zf_plddt.append((i, s, e, v.mean(), 100*(v > 70).mean(), d["strict"]))
    print("  ZF%-2d     %4d-%-4d   %8.1f   %6.1f   %s" % (i, s, e, v.mean(), 100*(v > 70).mean(), d["strict"]))
hdv = np.array([pl[k] for k in range(1043, 1103) if k in pl])
print("  homeodomain 1043-1102 %8.1f   %6.1f" % (hdv.mean(), 100*(hdv > 70).mean()))

# ---------------- figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.3))
ax[0].hist(fr, bins=20, color="#9aa7c7", edgecolor="white")
ax[0].axvline(fa2, color="#d1495b", lw=2.5)
ax[0].annotate("ADNP2 %.2f" % fa2, (fa2, ax[0].get_ylim()[1]*0.9), color="#d1495b", fontsize=10)
ax[0].set_xlabel("fraction of annotated C2H2 fingers matching C-x(2,4)-C-x(12)-H-x(3,5)-H")
ax[0].set_ylabel("human C2H2 proteins (n=%d)" % len(per_protein))
ax[0].set_title("Most human C2H2 proteins have mostly canonical fingers")
lab = ["ZF%d" % z[0] for z in zf_plddt] + ["HD"]
val = [z[3] for z in zf_plddt] + [hdv.mean()]
col = ["#2a9d8f" if z[5] else "#d1495b" for z in zf_plddt] + ["#4059ad"]
ax[1].bar(range(len(val)), val, color=col)
ax[1].axhline(70, color="black", ls="--", lw=1)
ax[1].axhline(allp.mean(), color="grey", ls=":", lw=1)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(val))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lab, rotation=0, fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("mean pLDDT")
ax[1].set_title("ADNP2 domains in AlphaFold: green canonical finger, red non-canonical\ndashed 70, dotted whole-chain mean %.1f" % allp.mean())
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
